vo_open.text: The biggest eyes of any animal. Ever.

vo.text: The colossal squid's eyes are up to thirty centimeters wide. Bigger than a football.
vo.cap: Eyes up to *30 cm.* Bigger than a *football.*

vo.text: The biggest one ever caught weighed four hundred ninety-five kilos. This one.
Its arms and tentacles carry hooks. Some of them swivel.
Sperm whales hunt them. Fourteen percent of the beaks in their stomachs are colossal squid.
vo.cap: *14%* of beaks in sperm whale stomachs.

vo.text: Adults live up to four thousand meters deep. Nobody filmed one alive until 2025.
vo.cap: No one filmed one alive until *2025.*

vo.text: Is there something even bigger down there? Yes or no? Tell me in the comments. And subscribe for more.
